checks.observation: The universal three-star and four-star theorems quantify arbitrary r and use M=F.card, with only uniformity, intersection and selected-point distinctness. Sunflower-freeness enters the assembled proof through degree<=19, pair-codegree<=6 and triple-codegree<=2. The pair bound uses a rank-two residual link; the triple bound uses a rank-one residual link. The pair cap also derives degree-sum constraints 34,46,60. The six-pair arithmetic bridge contains specialized constants 868 and 112 explicitly, and is not advertised as the generic family theorem.
